text: Recover a deleted note: open Trash in the sidebar, select the note and press Restore. A deleted note stays in Trash for 30 days.
Removed something by accident? Everything you discard is kept in the bin for a month, and one tap puts it back in its notebook.
Version history keeps earlier copies of every page, so you can roll back to how it looked yesterday or last week.
Delete a note by swiping left on it in the list and tapping Delete. Notes in a shared notebook are removed for every member.
Emptying the Trash permanently deletes every deleted note and frees up storage. Notes cannot be recovered afterwards.
Note templates let you start a new note from a ready-made layout such as meeting minutes or a weekly plan.
Offline mode: Lumen Notes works without an internet connection. Turn on Available offline for a notebook and edits sync when you reconnect.
No signal on a flight or in a tunnel? Pages you pinned to your device stay readable and editable, and changes upload once you are back online.
Sync status shows a small cloud icon; a crossed cloud means changes are waiting to be uploaded.
Connection problems: if Lumen Notes cannot connect to the server, check your network settings and try again.
Large attachments download on demand and are not stored on the device unless you pin them.
Keyboard shortcuts: press Ctrl+N for a new note, Ctrl+F to search, and Ctrl+P to print the current page.
Share a notebook: open the notebook menu, choose Share, and enter a teammate's email address. They receive an invitation to join.
To let a colleague collaborate, send them an invite from the notebook's people panel and pick whether they can edit or only read.
Permission levels: owners manage members, editors change pages, and viewers can only read and comment.
Sharing limits: a free workspace can share each notebook with up to five people.
Public links let anyone with the link read a page without signing in; turn a link off at any time.
Create a notebook from the plus button in the sidebar and pick a cover colour for it.
Export a note to PDF: open the note menu, choose Export, select PDF and save the file to your computer.
Need a printable copy? Use the download option on a page and pick the portable document format, headings and images included.
Markdown export saves a note as a plain text file that other editors can open; images are saved in a folder next to it.
Export limits: exporting an entire notebook at once is available on paid plans and may take a few minutes.
Import notes from other apps by choosing Import in settings and selecting a file.
Page covers: add a banner image at the top of any page from the Cover button.
Change the theme: open Settings, choose Appearance and select Dark, Light or System to switch the app to dark mode.
Easier on the eyes at night: pick the dim colour scheme in display preferences, or let the app follow your phone's setting.
Accent colours and font size can be changed in the same display preferences screen.
Theme gallery: browse notebook cover themes such as Paper, Forest and Sunset.
Change the app icon on iOS from Settings; a dark variant is included.
Spell check works in over forty languages and can be turned off for a notebook.
Reset your password: on the sign-in screen choose Forgot password, enter your email and follow the link we send you.
Locked out of your account? Ask for a recovery message on the login page and set a new secret from the link inside.
Two-step verification protects your account; keep your backup codes somewhere safe in case you lose your phone.
Change your password any time from Account settings; use at least twelve characters for a strong password.
Sign in with Google or Apple instead of creating a password, from the sign-in screen.
Delete your account from Account settings; all notebooks are removed after a 14-day grace period.
Recover a deleted note: open Trash in the sidebar, select the note and press Restore. A deleted note stays in Trash for 30 days.
